bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'IPC_STATUS='; git status --short -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_keepalive.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_public_video_actions.py
printf 'IPC_SOURCE_HASHES='; sha256sum scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_keepalive.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py
printf 'IPC_ACTIONS='; grep '^ACTIONS =' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || true
printf 'IPC_TEST='; python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health || true
printf 'IPC_PYTHON='; python3 -m py_compile scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py && echo COMPILE_PASS
